turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct. Why does my son's gradebook show a zero, and why did he see it on his phone in the middle of class?
Then finish. But I want to know who entered that zero, and whether anyone called me first.
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
I'm not every parent, I'm Owen's. Your own procedure says a parent is contacted before any mark goes in, so did that happen, yes or no?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then tell me what you have, Hale, and I'll stop asking. So far all I've heard is that you're busy.
